document-title: swelter — neighborhood heat & air evidence observatory
meta-description: Explore neighborhood heat and air evidence across place and time, with linked visualizations, calibration state, uncertainty, provenance, and accessible map, list, and table views.
document-title-openaq: swelter — California-region air-quality observations from OpenAQ
meta-description-openaq: Physical-sensor air-quality observations selected from OpenAQ for Swelter's California-region demo. Readings are uncalibrated by Swelter, timestamped, and shown provisional.
document-title-openmeteo: swelter — California air quality from Copernicus CAMS
meta-description-openmeteo: Hourly California air-quality model data from Copernicus CAMS via Open-Meteo, shown with weather context. These are model values, not neighborhood sensor readings.
meta-description-sensor-community: Timestamped low-cost air-sensor observations from Sensor.Community near Stuttgart. Swelter has not calibrated these readings, so they are shown provisional.
document-title-synthetic: swelter — synthetic heat and air-quality demonstration
meta-description-synthetic: A clearly labeled synthetic Swelter demonstration used only when live data sources are unavailable. It contains no real sensor observations.
tagline: Neighborhood heat and air quality, with calibration state and provenance shown.
now-intro: Find a location for a resident-first reading, then open the evidence behind it.
now-provisional-note: This reading is provisional; compare it with official advisories.
now-empty: No reading is available for this measurement at the selected observation.
now-search-empty: No location matching this search reports this measurement at the selected observation.
now-no-reading: No reading was published for this location at {time}.
now-gap: This gap is kept visible; swelter does not substitute another location or interpolate a value.
now-no-current: No observation at the selected time
observation-historical: Historical observation from {time} — not current conditions.
observation-stale: Latest loaded observation is from {time} and may be stale — not current conditions.
guidance-associated: Guidance associated with this recorded severity:
explore-heading: See place, time, and evidence together
explore-intro: Every view is linked. Change the hour, select a place, or adjust the evidence window and the map, ranking, and evidence panel stay in step.
range-note: The window contains published observations, not guaranteed hourly coverage. Missing intervals remain visible gaps and are never interpolated.
braid-key: Line = observed reading · band = published ± cell SE · hatch = provisional
braid-instructions: Use Left and Right Arrow to change the selected observation. Home and End jump to the edges of the evidence window. You can also click or tap anywhere in the plot to choose the nearest observation.
braid-selected-gap: {time}. {place}: no published reading at this observation.
braid-selected-empty: {time}. No location reports this measurement at this observation.
braid-se-note: For numeric measurements, the shaded band uses the published ± cell standard error. It is a lower-bound estimate of uncertainty, not a confidence interval.
braid-exposure-note: Selected observation method note: “{note}”. Heat + air exposure is a derived ordinal level, so this chart does not draw a numeric uncertainty band.
braid-no-band: No numeric uncertainty band is published for this measurement; the line still shows the reported observations.
braid-empty: Choose a location with published history to draw its exposure braid.
braid-summary: {place}: {n} qualified observations in the evidence window, {start} to {end}; low {min}, median {median}, high {max}; {provisional} provisional; {gaps} missing or excluded expected intervals.
braid-all-provisional: No confirmed history is available; this provisional series is rough.
braid-provisional-excluded: {n} provisional observation(s) excluded from this confirmed series.
distribution-key: Highest confirmed network readings at the selected observation
distribution-search-key: Highest confirmed matching locations at the selected observation
distribution-key-provisional: Highest provisional network readings — rough fallback; no confirmed readings
distribution-search-key-provisional: Highest provisional matching locations — rough fallback; no confirmed readings
distribution-note: Select a bar to link that location across every view. Confirmed readings are ranked when available; provisional readings are used only as a clearly labeled rough fallback. Pollutant bars start at zero, exposure bars use category levels, and temperature-like bars span the qualified network range; printed values and ranks are authoritative. Clear the location search to restore the whole network.
distribution-empty: No locations report this measurement at the selected observation.
distribution-search-empty: No location matching this search reports this measurement at the selected observation.
distribution-search-empty-confirmed: No confirmed matching location reports this measurement; provisional readings were excluded from the ranking.
inspector-empty: Select a place on the map, ranking, list, or table to inspect its trend, comparison, actions, uncertainty, and provenance.
network-intro: See coverage, sensor health, public alerts, and the places that may need attention.
method-intro: Source, calibration state, uncertainty, location privacy, and reuse terms stay attached to the reading.
locate-denied: Location not shared — search by name instead.
locate-unavailable: This device can't share a location — search by name instead.
coverage: {now} of {total} sensors reporting at this observation.
health-status: Sensor health as of {time}: {ok} ok · {degraded} degraded · {offline} offline.
overview-none-confirmed: No confirmed readings yet — all provisional at this observation.
overview-all-provisional-stats: All values are provisional; this range is rough.
overview-provisional-excluded: {n} provisional value(s) excluded from this confirmed range.
fresh-stale: This network may be behind — readings are not live.
offline-note: You're offline — showing the last readings this device loaded. Reconnect for the latest.
table-caption: Readings by location at the selected observation
map-hint: An interactive map of sensor locations — drag to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom, or use the buttons and arrow keys. Each marker states its reading in text; the same data is in the List and Table tabs for any reader the map does not serve.
map-aria: Sensor locations. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, arrow keys to move.
spark-label: {n} published observations from {start} to {end} — low {low}, high {high}{unit}.
spark-all-provisional: All plotted observations are provisional; this shape is rough.
spark-provisional-excluded: {n} provisional observation(s) excluded from this confirmed line.
headline-none: No confirmed air-quality readings at this observation — only provisional ones.
headline-worst: Worst confirmed air at this observation: {place} — AQI {aqi}, {category}.
guide-good: Air quality is good. It's a fine time to be active outside.
guide-moderate: Air quality is acceptable. Unusually sensitive people may want to take it easier on long or intense outdoor activity.
guide-usg: Sensitive groups — people with heart or lung disease, older adults, children, and teens — may feel effects and could shorten long or intense time outdoors. Others are less likely to be affected.
guide-unhealthy: Some people may feel effects; sensitive groups may feel more serious ones. Consider shorter or less intense time outdoors.
guide-vu: Health alert: everyone may feel effects. Sensitive groups should avoid outdoor exertion; others should limit it.
guide-haz: Health warning of emergency conditions: everyone should avoid outdoor exertion.
guide-source-heat: Heat context: US NWS heat index.
guide-source-both: Health context: US EPA AirNow and US NWS heat index.
act-note: Practical steps drawn from US EPA and NWS guidance — not medical advice.
act-calm: This recorded severity does not usually call for special heat or air precautions. Conditions can change fast — check current official alerts and go by how you feel.
act-heat-water: Drink water before you feel thirsty.
act-heat-shade: Take breaks in shade or air conditioning.
act-heat-easy: Avoid hard activity during the hottest hours.
act-heat-cool: Limit time outside and stay somewhere cool.
act-heat-signs: Watch for dizziness, nausea, or cramps — early signs of heat illness.
act-heat-neighbors: Check on older neighbors, kids, and anyone without air conditioning.
act-heat-ac: Get to air conditioning — a library, cooling center, or store all count.
act-heat-emergency: Hot dry skin, confusion, or fainting is a medical emergency — call for help.
act-air-sensitive: If you're unusually sensitive, take it easier on long or hard activity outside.
act-air-groups: Sensitive groups — asthma, heart or lung conditions, older adults, kids — should ease up outdoors.
act-air-inhaler: Keep quick-relief medication handy if you use it.
act-air-cutback: Cut back on time and effort outdoors.
act-air-windows: Keep windows closed; run an air filter if you have one.
act-air-mask: A well-fitting N95 or KN95 helps if you must be outside.
act-air-indoors: Stay indoors with windows closed if you can.
heat-guide-caution: Caution: fatigue is possible with prolonged time outside or activity. Take breaks, find shade, and drink water.
heat-guide-xcaution: Extreme caution: heat cramps and heat exhaustion are possible. Limit strenuous activity, rest in shade, and hydrate often.
heat-guide-danger: Danger: heat exhaustion is likely and heat stroke is possible with prolonged exposure. Avoid exertion, stay somewhere cool, and check on neighbors.
heat-guide-xdanger: Extreme danger: heat stroke is highly likely. Avoid being outside, seek air conditioning, and check on vulnerable neighbors.
context-top-hot: The hottest location in the network at this observation.
context-top-bad: The worst in the network at this observation.
context-rank-hot: {n} of {total} locations are hotter at this observation.
context-rank-bad: {n} of {total} locations are worse at this observation.
yesterday-same: About the same as this time yesterday.
prov-confirmed: Confirmed: calibrated against a reference monitor.
prov-provisional: Provisional: not yet calibrated against a reference monitor.
prov-derived: Combined from this area's heat and air readings.
compare-worse: {a} is worse than {b} at this observation.
compare-better: {a} is better than {b} at this observation.
compare-same: {a} and {b} are about the same at this observation.
compare-provisional: One or both readings are provisional (not yet calibrated), so this is a rough comparison.
history-all-provisional: All {n} observation(s) are provisional; this summary is rough.
history-provisional-excluded: {n} provisional observation(s) excluded from this confirmed summary.
alerts-note: Alerts evaluate only the newest published observation and update only while this page is open — there is no background push or account. Device notifications are suppressed when that observation is stale.
alert-line: {place}: at {time}, {param} was {reading} — at or past your alert level of {threshold}.
alert-provisional: This reading is still provisional (not yet calibrated), so treat it as rough.
alert-stale: This latest loaded observation is stale; verify current conditions before acting.
alert-observation-unavailable: The alert's observation from {time} is not in the loaded evidence window; the dashboard did not open a different time.
notify-body: Observation at {time}: {reading} — at or past your alert level of {threshold}.
aa-intro: Published areas where heat or air quality crossed a public-health danger threshold. Every result names its observation time. Aggregate environmental data — no account, no tracking.
aa-none: No danger-level heat or air alerts in the published feed as of {time}.
aa-stale: This feed is stale; verify current conditions before acting.
aa-heat: {area}: heat index was in the {sev} range at {time}.
aa-exposure: {area}: combined heat + air exposure was {sev} at {time}.
aa-prov: Still provisional (not yet calibrated) — treat as rough.
aa-copied: Feed link copied — paste it into any RSS/Atom reader to subscribe.
aa-copy-fail: Couldn't copy — the alert feed is at /api/alerts.xml.
aa-note: Subscribe by adding the alert feed to any RSS/Atom reader, or point an automation at it. The feed is public and carries no personal data; thresholds follow US-EPA and US-NWS bands.
aa-es-feed-note: Headlines and feed text are machine-translated, not reviewed by a person.
cooling-intro: Public places to cool down — libraries, community and senior centers, and cooled public buildings. The list below is the accessible equivalent of the map overlay; everything shown on the map is here in text.
cooling-show: Show cooling centers on the map
cooling-hide: Hide cooling centers on the map
cooling-shown: Cooling centers are now shown on the map.
cooling-hidden: Cooling centers are hidden on the map.
cool-distance: about {km} km from the selected location
watch-intro: Set a level for this measurement. While this page is open, you'll see an alert here when this location reaches it. Saved on this device only — no account, no server.
watch-number-label: Alert at this reading or higher
watch-need-value: Enter a number to alert at first.
notify-granted: On-device notifications are on for this browser.
notify-blocked: Notifications aren't on — the in-page alerts still work.
copy-fail: Couldn't copy — copy the address bar instead.
brief-done: Summary copied — paste it into an email, a flyer, or testimony.
brief-source: Source: swelter community sensor network — open data (CC0).
brief-network: Copy a summary of the whole network
brief-network-done: Network summary copied — paste it into an article, a report, or testimony.
share-card-window: Reading reflects this location's hourly mean for the selected hour, not a 24-hour average.
share-card-fail: Couldn't create the share card image.
legend-wbgt-note: This is an estimated wet-bulb globe temperature, from air temperature and humidity only — there is no black-globe sensor and no solar-radiation term, so it reads cooler than a true outdoor WBGT in direct sun. Shown by its value on each marker, with "estimated" always alongside the number; see the List or Table view for every location.
heat-band-note: The shading is a coolest-to-hottest cue only — the number on each marker is the exact reading, in your chosen units.
exp-level-minimal: Minimal — little added heat or air stress
exp-level-high: High — limit time and exertion outdoors
legend-value-note: This measurement is shown by its value on each marker, not by a severity category. Higher numbers mean more of the pollutant; see the List or Table view for every location.
what-is-aqi-body: The Air Quality Index (AQI) turns a pollution concentration into a 0–500 scale and a named category. Higher is worse: 0–50 is Good, 100+ starts to affect sensitive people.
aqi-usg: Unhealthy for sensitive groups — AQI 101 to 150
aqi-window: The AQI shown is computed from each location's hourly mean, not a 24-hour average.
provisional: Provisional locations have only early, uncalibrated readings — still being double-checked, and never shown as a confirmed category. Status is conveyed by text and pattern, not color alone.
exp-note: Heat + air exposure combines the heat index and the PM2.5 AQI into one level (Minimal to Extreme), taking the higher of the two and flagging when heat and air are both elevated. It is decision-support, not a validated health index, and never a claim that conditions are safe.
how-to-read: How to read this — and what it does not say
method-calibration: Confirmed means calibrated against a reference monitor; a sensor with no fit stays raw and is shown provisional.
method-uncertainty: Every confirmed reading carries a ± 1-sigma uncertainty, published alongside it.
method-location: Published locations snap to a ~150 m grid, so the map shows the area, not the porch.
method-aqi: The AQI shown comes from each location's hourly mean, not the official 24-hour average.
method-exposure: Heat + air exposure takes the higher of the heat and air levels — it never blends them into one number.
method-open: Reuse terms and attribution depend on the active source and are shown above. Readings are downloadable without an account or key.
trust-summary: Confirmed readings are calibrated against a reference monitor and carry a ± uncertainty. Provisional readings are early and uncalibrated. This page reports what the air and heat readings are; it does not tell anyone they are safe. Use it alongside how you feel and official advisories.
trust-safety: These readings do not tell anyone they are safe. Use them alongside how you feel and official advisories.
footer-data: Reuse terms for the active source are shown above. Download the full history — no account, no key.
footer-note: Each reading carries its calibration state and, when calibrated, a published uncertainty.
settings-intro: swelter keeps your choices in this browser only — no account, no server. That's your language, units, text size, contrast, any alert thresholds you set, and the last location you opened.
settings-has: Saved on this device now: {n} alert(s), plus your language, units, and display choices.
settings-empty: Nothing is saved on this device yet.
settings-cleared: Saved settings cleared from this device.
no-data: No data yet. Run `swelter demo --serve` or `make demo`.
